## Read the data

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dev = c("png","pdf"),
  dpi = 300,
  fig.path = "figures/"
)

library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(cluster)

raw <- read_tsv("source/MamFuncDat.txt", col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
                na = character(), skip_empty_rows = FALSE)
mdd <- read_csv("source/MDD_v2.5_6904species.csv",
                col_types = cols(.default = "c"), na = character())
tree_tax <- read_csv("source/taxonomy_mamPhy_5911species_toPublish.csv",
                     col_types = cols(.default = "c"), na = character())
source_tree <- read.tree(paste0(
  "Completed_5911sp_topoCons_FBDasZhouEtAl/",
  "MamPhy_BDvr_Completed_5911sp_topoCons_FBDasZhouEtAl_v2_tree0000.tre"
))
normal_name <- function(x) str_trim(str_replace_all(x, "_", " "))
```

## Select marsupials

```{r}
families <- c(
  "Didelphidae", "Caenolestidae", "Microbiotheriidae", "Dasyuridae",
  "Myrmecobiidae", "Notoryctidae", "Peramelidae", "Thylacomyidae",
  "Phascolarctidae", "Vombatidae", "Burramyidae", "Phalangeridae",
  "Pseudocheiridae", "Petauridae", "Tarsipedidae", "Acrobatidae",
  "Hypsiprymnodontidae", "Potoroidae", "Macropodidae"
)
mars_raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(source_row = row_number(), Scientific = normal_name(Scientific)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Scientific), !Scientific %in% c("", "NA"), MSWFamilyLatin %in% families)
nrow(mars_raw)
```

## Match species names and the tree

```{r}
# Keep names that identify exactly one MDD record.
mdd_names <- mdd %>%
  select(mdd_id = id, sciName, MSW3_sciName,
         mdd_extinct = extinct, diffSinceMSW3, countryDistribution,
         continentDistribution) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(sciName, MSW3_sciName), values_to = "Scientific") %>%
  mutate(Scientific = normal_name(Scientific)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Scientific), !Scientific %in% c("", "NA")) %>%
  distinct(Scientific, mdd_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  add_count(Scientific) %>%
  filter(n == 1) %>%
  select(-name, -n)

marsupial_source_tree <- keep.tip(source_tree, tree_tax %>%
  filter(higher == "Marsupialia", Species_Name %in% source_tree$tip.label) %>%
  pull(Species_Name))
tree_names <- tree_tax %>%
  filter(extinct. == "0", Species_Name %in% marsupial_source_tree$tip.label) %>%
  transmute(Scientific = normal_name(Species_Name), tree_tip = Species_Name)
mars <- mars_raw %>%
  inner_join(mdd_names, by = "Scientific") %>%
  filter(mdd_extinct == "0", diffSinceMSW3 == "0") %>%
  inner_join(tree_names, by = "Scientific")
```

## Select regions and reliable traits

```{r}
american_families <- c("Didelphidae", "Caenolestidae", "Microbiotheriidae")
diet_columns <- paste0("Diet-", c(
  "Inv", "Vend", "Vect", "Vfish", "Vunk", "Scav", "Fruit", "Nect", "Seed", "PlantO"
))
mars <- mars %>%
  mutate(
    australia = str_detect(countryDistribution, "(^|\\|)\\s*Australia\\s*(\\||$)"),
    americas = str_detect(continentDistribution, "(^|\\|)\\s*(North|South) America\\s*(\\||$)"),
    american_family = MSWFamilyLatin %in% american_families,
    region = case_when(
      australia & !americas & !american_family ~ "Australia",
      americas & !australia & american_family ~ "Americas"
    ),
    across(all_of(c(diet_columns, "BodyMass-Value")), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(region), !countryDistribution %in% c("", "NA"),
    `Diet-Certainty` == "ABC", `ForStrat-Certainty` == "A", `BodyMass-SpecLevel` == "1",
    `ForStrat-Value` %in% c("G", "S", "Ar", "A", "M"),
    is.finite(`BodyMass-Value`), `BodyMass-Value` > 0,
    if_all(all_of(diet_columns), ~ is.finite(.x) & between(.x, 0, 100)),
    abs(rowSums(select(., all_of(diet_columns))) - 100) < 1e-8
  ) %>%
  add_count(mdd_id, name = "id_n") %>%
  add_count(tree_tip, name = "tip_n") %>%
  filter(id_n == 1, tip_n == 1) %>%
  select(source_row, Scientific, tree_tip, region,
         `BodyMass-Value`, `ForStrat-Value`, all_of(diet_columns))
mars
```

## Define dietary groups

I assume that if any kind of diet is over 50, this species is in this diet group. If tnere is not any kind of diet over 50%, put it in Omnivores. 

```{r}
# More than 50% defines the dominant food group.

mars <- mars %>%
  mutate(
    vertebrate_percent = `Diet-Vend` + `Diet-Vect` + `Diet-Vfish` + `Diet-Vunk`,
    plant_percent = `Diet-Fruit` + `Diet-Nect` + `Diet-Seed` + `Diet-PlantO`,
    diet_group = case_when(
      `Diet-Inv` > 50 ~ "Invertebrates",
      vertebrate_percent > 50 ~ "Vertebrates",
      plant_percent > 50 ~ "Plants",
      TRUE ~ "Omnivores"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source_row, Scientific, tree_tip, region, diet_group,
         `BodyMass-Value`, `ForStrat-Value`)
head(mars)
mars %>% count(diet_group, region)
```

## Final dataset

```{r}
analysis_tree <- keep.tip(marsupial_source_tree, mars$tree_tip)
mars <- mars[match(analysis_tree$tip.label, mars$tree_tip), ]
mars_regions <- mars
mars_australia <- filter(mars, region == "Australia")
mars_americas <- filter(mars, region == "Americas")
excluded_records <- anti_join(mars_raw, mars, by = "source_row")
mars %>% count(region)
mars_australia
excluded_records
```

## Overall Gower distances

```{r}
gower_summary <- function(dat, include_diet = FALSE) {
  traits <- dat %>%
    transmute(log_mass = log10(`BodyMass-Value`), # log the weight
              stratum = factor(`ForStrat-Value`)) # define the startum
  weights <- c(1, 1)

  if (include_diet) {
    # Diet is same groups score 0, different groups score 1.
    traits <- mutate(traits, diet_group = factor(dat$diet_group))
    weights <- c(1, 1, 1)  # Equal weights
  }

  D <- as.matrix(daisy(as.data.frame(traits), metric = "gower",
                       weights = weights, warnBin = FALSE))
  au <- dat$region == "Australia"
  am <- dat$region == "Americas"
  mean_within <- function(index) {
    if (sum(index) < 2) return(NA)  # At least two species
    within <- D[index, index, drop = FALSE]
    mean(within[lower.tri(within)]) 
  }
  au_mean <- mean_within(au)
  am_mean <- mean_within(am)
  tibble(n_Australia = sum(au), n_Americas = sum(am),
         mean_Australia = au_mean, mean_Americas = am_mean,
         delta = au_mean - am_mean)
}

overall_gower <- gower_summary(mars, include_diet = TRUE)
overall_gower
```

## Gower distances within dietary groups

```{r}

group_gower <- bind_rows(
  Invertebrates = gower_summary(filter(mars, diet_group == "Invertebrates")),
  Vertebrates = gower_summary(filter(mars, diet_group == "Vertebrates")),
  Plants = gower_summary(filter(mars, diet_group == "Plants")),
  Omnivores = gower_summary(filter(mars, diet_group == "Omnivores")),
  .id = "group"
)
group_gower

delta_inv <- group_gower$delta[group_gower$group == "Invertebrates"]
delta_ver <- group_gower$delta[group_gower$group == "Vertebrates"]
delta_plant <- group_gower$delta[group_gower$group == "Plants"]

```


```{r gower_plots}
plot_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(overall_gower, group = "Overall"),
  group_gower
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("Overall", "Invertebrates", "Vertebrates",
                 "Plants", "Omnivores")
    ),
    analysis = if_else(group == "Overall",
                       "Overall: three traits", "Within groups: two traits")
  )

plot_long <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(c(mean_Australia, mean_Americas),
               names_to = "region", values_to = "mean_gower") %>%
  mutate(
    region = str_remove(region, "mean_"),
    n = if_else(region == "Australia", n_Australia, n_Americas)
  )

region_colours <- c(Australia = "#BCEB0C", Americas = "#892F99")




ggplot(plot_long, aes(group, mean_gower, colour = region, shape = region)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.45), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.45),
            vjust = -1, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(~ analysis, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = region_colours) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Australia = 16, Americas = 17)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean within-region Gower distance",
       colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")



delta_limit <- max(abs(plot_data$delta)) * 1.25

ggplot(plot_data, aes(group, delta)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_col(aes(fill = if_else(delta > 0, "Australia", "Americas")),
           width = 0.55, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", delta),
                vjust = if_else(delta > 0, -0.5, 1.5)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-delta_limit, delta_limit)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Gower difference (Australia - Americas)") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r PCA_plots}
pcoa_plot <- function(dat, include_diet = FALSE, title = "PCoA") {

  traits <- dat %>%
    transmute(log_mass = log10(`BodyMass-Value`),
              stratum = factor(`ForStrat-Value`))

  if (include_diet) {
    traits$diet_group <- factor(dat$diet_group)
  }

  D <- cluster::daisy(
    as.data.frame(traits), metric = "gower",
    weights = rep(1, ncol(traits)), warnBin = FALSE
  )

  # Correct negative eigenvalues for plotting only.
  fit <- ape::pcoa(D, correction = "lingoes", rn = dat$Scientific)
  corrected <- !is.null(fit$vectors.cor)

  # Use coordinates and percentages from the same solution.
  axes <- if (corrected) fit$vectors.cor else fit$vectors
  proportion <- if (corrected) fit$values$Rel_corr_eig else fit$values$Relative_eig

  plot_data <- dat %>%
    mutate(PCoA1 = axes[, 1], PCoA2 = axes[, 2])

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, colour = region)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_equal() +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(Australia = "#BCEB0C", Americas = "#892F99")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      colour = "Region",
      x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", 100 * proportion[1]),
      y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", 100 * proportion[2]),
      caption = if (corrected) "Lingoes-corrected Gower distances" else "Gower distances"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # Show dietary groups as different shapes in the overall plot.
  if (include_diet) {
    p <- p + aes(shape = diet_group) + labs(shape = "Diet group")
  }

  p
}

pcoa_plot(mars, include_diet = TRUE, title = "Overall PCoA")

pcoa_plot(
  filter(mars, diet_group == "Invertebrates"),
  title = "Invertebrates"
)

pcoa_plot(
  filter(mars, diet_group == "Vertebrates"),
  title = "Vertebrates"
)

pcoa_plot(
  filter(mars, diet_group == "Plants"),
  title = "Plants"
)

pcoa_plot(
  filter(mars, diet_group == "Omnivores"),
  title = "Omnivores / residual category"
)


```

tree_regions <- mars$region[match(analysis_tree$tip.label, mars$tree_tip)]
edge_colours <- region_colours[tree_regions[analysis_tree$edge[, 2]]]
edge_colours[is.na(edge_colours)] <- "grey60"

# Keep labels black and make branches thicker.
plot(analysis_tree, use.edge.length = TRUE, cex = 0.6,
     tip.color = "black",
     edge.color = edge_colours,
     edge.width = 3)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Australia", "Americas"),
       col = region_colours[c("Australia", "Americas")],
       lty = 1, lwd = 3,
       bty = "n", cex = 0.9)
